full_page.content:
1925, April
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
Page 22 Cont.
April 21 Blind Baby Enrolled 2nd time. Bernard Anezak, 18 months old hope- less to all doctors is enrolled again this evening for 2 yrs.
Page 23
April 24 Paralisis Improving. Mrs. Minina La Porte 55 Enrolled April 15th as a helpless case of paralicis, reported to-day as able that same night to change position in bed without help. - first time in five years. she turned on in f- ( incomplete)
26th Sleeping Sickness & Paralisis. Alex H. Smith 38 - 4472Field Ave. having wife and 4 children invalid five years - last 3 yrs has to be dressed so helpless, is enrolled to-night. We leave him to Jesus.
A Kluxer Enrolled. Herman Fickweiler, bitter against church, in- sists on bringing children to anything but Catholic Church is en- rolled to-night.
May 11th Sister M. Immaculata of Chatam, Ont. Ursuline Convent - 40 - Hem- orages of eyes - Blind in one and
May 25 th Safety Pin swallowed by Child
Anna Smolinska 23 - 6344 Dubois - leakage of heart since one year old, can not hold any food in stommach. Enrolled this evening per- petually - Next evening reported no change. P.S. Aug. 9th '28 Above noted A.S. was enrolled again the following year after speci- alists from all over had given up hopes. "Nothing can be done" She recovers quite normal so as to be anxious to get work in factory.
May 28 Cancer & Gall-stones Mrs. Rose (Vallie) Cottrell 31, mother of 4 small children, now in St. Joseph's Saintorium Mt. Clement where she relieved recently of gall-stones and last Tuesday of a very threatening groth - believed to be cancer is enrolled to-day
May 28 Patrick McDonough 32 Michigan & Boulivard enrolled three weeks ago not able to stand expected to die any day without Priest. now able to walk out - went to confession two days after enrollment.
May 30th Failing Sight Restored. Sister Cathleen - Ursuline - Ford Windsor, Ont. Enrolled 2nd time To-day Mayo Bro's - declare as destined to be blind - already so in one eye. Same hopeless decisions wher- ever effort has been made for relief. Later on is reported O.K.
